content.user_title: Build Declarative Data Pipelines with mloda
content.value_statement: AI agents often generate fragile data-fetching and transformation code. This skill uses mloda feature requests, plugins, and lineage to build deterministic data workflows.
actual_capabilities: Check loaded FeatureGroup documentation after initializing installed plugins.
Convert JSON feature requests into mloda features and execute them across supported compute frameworks.
Supply inline API data or connect data through DataAccessCollection.
Express multi-step transformations through chained feature names when every required plugin is installed.
Prepare reusable execution plans for repeated, latency-sensitive requests.
limitations: Does not create missing plugins; use separate mloda-plugins guidance.
Registry documentation can drift from installed packages.
Feature chains fail when any required FeatureGroup is unavailable.
Security and authorization controls for model-generated requests must be added by the integrator.

use_cases.title: Reuse Existing Transformations
use_cases.description: Inspect installed plugins before implementing aggregation, ranking, time-series, or string transformations.

use_cases.title: Build Agent Data Tools
use_cases.description: Translate constrained model requests into deterministic feature computations with source lineage.

use_cases.title: Optimize Repeated Workloads
use_cases.description: Prepare execution plans once and reuse them for serving, streaming, or dashboard requests.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Available Plugins
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the installed mloda plugins for [feature need]. List matching FeatureGroups, required packages, supported frameworks, and missing capabilities before proposing code.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Feature Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a mloda request for [features] using [input source]. Use [framework], explain dependencies, and include lineage checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a feature-name chain for [RAG workflow]. Map each stage to an existing plugin, identify unavailable stages, and define validation boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Harden a Reusable Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reusable mloda session for [workload]. Add a strict feature allowlist, option validation, data-access boundaries, lineage verification, and latency measurements.

output_examples.input: Check whether installed plugins can calculate ranked revenue by region.
output_examples.output: Registry check: a ranking FeatureGroup is available for Pandas. Review and pin the required community package before use.

output_examples.input: Plan a retrieval, injection check, and PII redaction workflow.
output_examples.output: The workflow needs three FeatureGroups in dependency order. Validate each plugin and authorize the final request before execution.

output_examples.input: Reduce latency for repeated customer feature requests.
output_examples.output: Prepare one reusable execution session, supply request data per run, and measure planning and execution latency separately.

best_practices: Inspect installed plugin documentation before writing custom transformations.
Pin and review packages before installation in production.
Validate model-generated feature names and options against an explicit allowlist.
anti_patterns: Do not assume registry documentation matches the current environment.
Do not execute unrestricted model-generated requests against sensitive data.
Do not rebuild execution plans for every repeated request when prepare can reuse them.

faq.question: What is mloda?
faq.answer: mloda is a Python plugin framework that resolves named feature requests into executable data workflows with lineage.

faq.question: Does this skill install packages automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides installation guidance, but package selection and installation require review in your environment.

faq.question: Can it create a missing plugin?
faq.answer: No. This skill identifies missing coverage and directs plugin creation to separate mloda-plugins guidance.

faq.question: Which compute frameworks are supported?
faq.answer: Examples include PandasDataFrame, PyArrowTable, and PythonDictFramework. Actual availability depends on installed plugins.

faq.question: How does lineage work?
faq.answer: mloda records dependencies from requested features through their source data and transformation chain.

faq.question: Is model-generated configuration safe to execute directly?
faq.answer: No. Validate feature names and options, restrict data access, and authorize requests before execution.
